condition.$comment: Assessed by engine/onboard.py. Floor may not be overridden downward (ADR-006). execution remains unbound on purpose: no Beads/execution-file exists, and fabricating one would be silent infrastructure (INV-013).

permissions.$comment: Deny by default (ADR-005). Unlisted roles and verbs are deny. The only write grant is decision_history so envelope.py --record can persist CAPTURE_ONLY. The engine still rules; this grant does not change the repository product.
